summary: MMX-accelerated polyphase audio resampler. Decrements and masks a 4-bit phase counter at this+0x24BC, then, while the channel count at this+0x24CC is positive, iterates channels and calls F_3DTransformWithSIMD (00534120) on each source block. Per block it applies a pmaddwd/packssdw convolution: a stereo path when the channel count equals 2 uses the coefficient tables unk_8B3724 (544-byte phase stride) and unk_8B1924 (480-byte phase stride), while the mono path uses unk_5B730C (2-byte back-offset stride). Convolution results are packed and written as interleaved 16-bit PCM to the output word pointer. Invoked by CompressedAudioDecoder (0052E6F0) and TextureDecompression_1250 (00531250) during audio decode.

local_names.this: audio resampler instance carrying phase state and channel count
local_names.a3: source/coefficient working pointer advanced per channel
local_names.v391: phase-derived index selecting the polyphase coefficient table offset

operations.description: Phase counter advance: reads the byte at this+0x24BC, decrements it and masks to 4 bits, writes the result back; the masked phase selects an even/odd offset used to index the coefficient tables
Processing runs only while the signed channel count at this+0x24CC is greater than 0 (packet guard)
Per-channel loop: iterates once per channel, using the count at this+0x24CC, advancing the transform argument and output pointer by fixed strides each iteration
F_3DTransformWithSIMD (00534120) applied to each channel's block; the transform argument is offset by the live phase counter byte at this+0x24BC
Within a channel, the convolution splits on whether the channel count at this+0x24CC equals 2: equal selects the stereo coefficient path, otherwise the mono path is used (packet guard)

Stereo convolution: 16-bit multiply-add (pmaddwd) and multiply-high (pmulhw) accumulation of the transform block against the unk_8B3724 table (544 * phase) and unk_8B1924 table (480 * phase), with packssdw conversion, written as interleaved 16-bit PCM to the output pointer
Mono convolution: same pmaddwd/pmulhw accumulation against the unk_5B730C mono coefficient table, addressed with a 2-byte back-offset scaled by the phase, written as single-channel PCM
Returns the terminal channel iteration count (derived from the this+0x24CC loop bound)
Invoked by CompressedAudioDecoder (0052E6F0) and TextureDecompression_1250 (00531250) as part of the audio decode/render path
